title: Is there any limitation for free plan?
content: The free plan gives you access to real-time exchange rates and basic conversions. Advanced features such as custom alerts, historical reports, and priority support require an upgrade.

title: What is the minimum specification to run the apps on Android or iOS?
content: Cofile runs on Android 8.0+ and iOS 14+. We recommend at least 2GB of RAM and a stable internet connection for the best experience.

title: Can I downgrade the plan?
content: Yes, you can downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
